notes.title: Open your world
notes.content:
A catastrophe has reduced the world to rubble, leaving you to fight for survival in a ruthless world full of hunger, danger and mutated creatures. Gather resources, build weapons and fortifications, seek shelter and stay alert - every mistake could cost you your life. Survival is not just a goal, it's a daily struggle.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3328940/The_Isolated/]Open your world[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content: By popular demand, added additional batteries, all over the map. From the big updates added graphics settings in the menu and in the tab pause, during the game.
